CommunityApplications.Profile:
Repository for **Mularr**, a modern web interface and automation bridge for **aMule**.
Mularr exposes qBittorrent-compatible APIs and Torznab indexers so you can plug the eD2k network straight into Sonarr, Radarr and other *Arr apps. It also supports the Telegram network as a download provider, Telegram notifications, and Gluetun (VPN) integration with automatic forwarded-port updates.
For support, please open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/joecarl/mularr/issues
